decision_summary: Visionary, Builder, and Guardian approve v0.6.37 Reviewer Disagreement Calibration with dissent-preservation boundaries.
rationale: The slice makes independent judgments, exact disagreement dimensions, adjudication authority, overrides, and unresolved plurality auditable without treating agreement, majority, seniority, confidence, or adjudication as semantic truth.
recommendation: Implement the narrow calibration-report extension and release only after retained negative fixtures, full QIF verification, self-review, and retrospective.
target_audience: QIF users, AI agents, accountable reviewers, domain specialists, operators, and affected stakeholders
expected_user_reaction: Users can see where reviewers disagree, what each reviewer observed, how adjudication changed the operational disposition, and what remains uncertain.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add reviewer disagreement policy, judgments, disagreement records, adjudication outcomes, assessments, examples, verifier rules, fixtures, plain-language documentation, roadmap, and release evidence.
